svg.title: Enterprise Knowledge AI System — Current Technical Architecture, Lean RAG MVP, RV-045
svg.desc: Dark navy and cyan technical architecture: offline enterprise sources, normalization, evidence units, verified catalog and embeddings; online private Streamlit UI through KnowledgeService, vector and BM25 retrieval, evidence assembly, generation, structural gates, independent LLM verification, Python post-checks and cited response. Cost and scope guards, and clearly excluded enterprise features.
svg.text: CURRENT TECHNICAL ARCHITECTURE / LEAN RAG MVP / RV-045
Evidence-first architecture • Source provenance • Bounded execution • Explicit abstention
BUILD-TIME · NOT RUN FOR EACH QUESTION
Corpus revisions require a controlled offline rebuild; source integrity is verified when KnowledgeService loads.
Bounded: at most one additional retrieval; accepted citations must map to the authenticated catalog snapshot.
Model verification is a review signal, not a semantic or compliance certification.
Canonical IDs • source hashes • budgets • bounded recovery • citations
SSO / ACL • persistent store • REST API • semantic certification
